name: @corbits-builder/cloudflare-publish
description: Gets a built app ready to publish on Cloudflare Workers: checks it has what a deploy needs, then that the Worker is routed to a domain.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The project has an app and the person wants it published on Cloudflare Workers.
builder.unless: The app is meant for another host, or the project has no app yet.

steps.title: Check the app is ready for Cloudflare
Check the Worker is routed to a domain

examples: put the app on Cloudflare Workers
